completion_data.completion_summary: Authored agent-system/extensions/core/context/patterns/external-process-wait.md (129 lines) stating the observed external-process-wait defect class once and defining the six mandatory wait rules (bounded blocking wait with 540<600 arithmetic, no no-op filler, no run_in_background/Monitor for CI waits in a subagent, state-change-only Monitor emission, independent local work first, 45-minute total-wait cap with handoff+partial), added a discoverable on-demand index-entries.json entry, and added a one-line anti-stop-patterns.md pointer without restating the rules.

memory_candidates.content: When editing a core context/patterns/*.md file that is also indexed in index-entries.json, re-measure wc -l after the edit and correct that file's own line_count entry in the same commit -- even a small pointer-line addition (e.g. +3 lines) can desync the index and trip check-extension-docs.sh's Rule R line_count-mismatch gate. Catching and fixing self-introduced drift in the same commit is cheaper than a later dedicated gate discovering it.
